title: recommendations deliverable rubric
description: Per-deliverable expert subagent for #recommendations output. Audits the verbalized-sampling consensus + non-obvious bet split, the per-tile execution depth (clr_dependent, execution_path, existing_stack_reuse, non_starter_check, key_stakeholders, implementation_steps, risks_constraints, expected_impact), and the four-tuple quantification per the quantification-architect skill. Returns a structured verdict the orchestrator must respond to before recommendations ship.

anchors.5: fully meets the criterion as the five column states
anchors.3: present but partially met or partially traced
anchors.1: absent, fabricated, or as the one column states

criteria.label: VS framing
criteria.five: Both concepts_defensible_consensus (3-6) AND concepts_non_obvious_bets (2-5) populated; each tile carries frame + probability + (bets only) diverges_from
criteria.one: Single flat concepts array; no VS-discipline

criteria.label: Tile execution depth
criteria.five: Every tile has clr_dependent (boolean OR null with justification), execution_path (named systems), existing_stack_reuse (named tools), non_starter_check (explicit), key_stakeholders (named roles), implementation_steps (3+ owner+effort), risks_constraints (3+ with severity+mitigation), expected_impact, verbatim_quote_evidence

criteria.label: Four-tuple quantification
criteria.five: Every tile's expected_impact carries: baseline (sourced), target (committed delta with date), measurement instrument named, refresh cadence

criteria.label: Engagement_context coherence
criteria.five: Every non-starter from the prompt is honored in every tile; preferred stack used by default; deviations justified

criteria.label: Evidence diversity
criteria.five: Every tile cites ≥2 evidence_sources by name; cross-tile diversity (not all 12 tiles citing the same 4 sources)

criteria.label: Quantitative discipline (titles)
criteria.five: Numbers in titles only appear inside cited quotes; standalone "%/X-times" banned

criteria.label: Anti-slop
criteria.five: No meta-commentary; no metaphors; no hyperbole (hyperbole from the banned list, hyperbole from the banned list); no "as we'll see"; no em-dashes

criteria.label: Persona + moment specificity
criteria.five: persona references a named persona from the personas deliverable (or a named role); moment is a specific time/event in that persona's workflow, not "when they need help"

criteria.label: aha_interaction concreteness
criteria.five: The aha_interaction describes what the user SEES, CLICKS, or HEARS, a concrete UI moment

criteria.label: Build-variant viability
criteria.five: Each tile has 2-3 variants (e.g., #proto, #brief, #blueprint) with a real one-line command that would actually build something downstream

criteria.label: Cached-selection coverage
criteria.five: ≥80% of the user's KL-curated items appear in the emission as source: cached or source: extended; new items have source: new; coverage is reported as cached_selection_coverage_pct in the verdict
criteria.one: <60% coverage (auto Stop-hook reject via validate_cached_selection_honored.py); model regenerated from scratch and ignored the user's curation

decision.approve: all dimensions ≥3 AND VS framing ≥4 AND tile execution depth ≥4 AND four-tuple quantification ≥3
decision.revise: 1-2 dimensions below floor; orchestrator regenerates via critic-revise-loop
decision.reject: 3+ dimensions below floor OR engagement_context non-starter violated OR fabricated quotes

verdict_rule.refine: any criterion scored below its floor
verdict_rule.pass: every scored criterion at or above its floor
